heading: SPECIAL INVESTIGATIONS UNIT
text:
SIU Investigation Process

SIU investigators conduct in-depth reviews of flagged claims. Investigation tools include recorded statement analysis, social media monitoring, surveillance, and collaboration with law enforcement. SIU cases are managed in a dedicated case management system with strict access controls.

Fraud Referral and Prosecution

Confirmed fraud cases are referred to the appropriate state insurance fraud bureau and, where warranted, to law enforcement for criminal prosecution. Civil recovery actions may also be pursued. All referrals are logged and tracked for regulatory reporting purposes.
summary: The Special Investigations Unit (SIU) handles flagged insurance claims through detailed investigations utilizing advanced tools and collaborates with law enforcement for fraud prosecution, while maintaining strict case management and regulatory tracking procedures.

heading: POLICY ORIGINATION
text:
Policy origination encompasses the activities required to bring a new policy into force. This begins when a prospective customer submits an application, either through an agent, broker, or digital self-service portal. The origination team collects applicant information including personal details, risk exposure, and prior coverage history.

Underwriting Rules

Underwriting rules define the criteria by which an application is accepted, modified, or declined. Rules are calibrated to the company's risk appetite and updated quarterly based on loss experience. Key underwriting factors include applicant age, prior claims history, geographic location, and asset value. Automated underwriting engines process the majority of standard applications within minutes, while complex or high-value policies are routed to senior underwriters for manual review.

Policy Issuance

Upon underwriting approval, the policy document is generated and issued to the policyholder. The issuance process includes premium calculation, payment schedule setup, and document delivery. All issued policies are registered in the core policy administration system with a unique policy number and effective date.
summary: The "Policy Origination" process involves initiating a new insurance policy through application submission, underwriting based on predefined rules aligned with risk tolerance, and policy issuance, including premium calculation, document delivery, and registration in the policy administration system.

heading: POLICY TERMINATION
text: Policies may be terminated by the insurer for non-payment, material misrepresentation, or at the policyholder's request. The termination process includes calculation of any unearned premium refund, notification to lienholders, and update of the policy administration system. Terminated policies are archived and retained per regulatory requirements.
summary: The "POLICY TERMINATION" section outlines the conditions under which an insurance policy may be terminated, the procedural steps such as refund calculations, lienholder notifications, and archival, adhering to regulatory requirements.

heading: POLICY LIFECYCLE MANAGEMENT
text:
Introduction

This document outlines the end-to-end lifecycle of an insurance policy from initial application through renewal and termination. Effective policy lifecycle management is critical to maintaining profitability, customer satisfaction, and regulatory compliance.
summary: The "POLICY LIFECYCLE MANAGEMENT" section describes the complete process of managing an insurance policy, emphasizing its importance for profitability, customer satisfaction, and compliance.
